title: Phase 52: Pipeline Integration & Adaptive Intelligence
goal: Wire Phase 51 modules (isotonic calibrator, pattern gate, setup quality filter, tranche tracker, walk-forward retrainer) into the live execution pipeline. stories.title: Confidence decomposition into directional/timing/magnitude components
acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/confidence_decomposer.py with ConfidenceDecomposer class
Decompose raw confidence into 3 components: directional_strength (0-1), timing_quality (0-1), magnitude_estimate (0-1)
directional_strength: agent agreement on direction × trend alignment
timing_quality: session alignment × MTF confluence signal × duration sweet spot
magnitude_estimate: ATR percentile × regime-conditional expected move
Recompose: weighted average (direction 0.45, timing 0.30, magnitude 0.25)
Apply high-confidence penalty: if recomposed > 0.70 and directional_strength < 0.55, cap at 0.65
Wire into _team.py evaluate() after isotonic calibration
At least 10 unit tests
stories.notes: ConfidenceDecomposer created (~220 lines), wired into _team.py evaluate() after isotonic. 4 call sites in _team.py.

stories.title: Adaptive R:R targeting by regime and confidence
acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/adaptive_rr.py with AdaptiveRRCalculator class
Regime-based R:R targets: LOW(1.5:1), NORMAL(1.8:1), HIGH(2.2:1), EXTREME(2.5:1)
Confidence-modulated: high confidence (>0.65) tightens R:R by 0.2, low (<0.45) widens by 0.3
Override atr_tp_multiplier in execution.py based on adaptive R:R recommendation
Minimum R:R floor of 1.2:1 always enforced (trading rule)
Log R:R adjustment with regime, confidence, and final target
Track R:R vs outcome to measure if higher targets reduce win rate proportionally
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: AdaptiveRRCalculator created (~165 lines), wired into execution.py pre-exec chain (overrides atr_tp_multiplier, restores after sizing). Outcome recording in sync_closed_trades_rl. 18 tests (12 unit + 5 wiring + 1 lazy import).

stories.title: Drawdown-adaptive behavior (pair rotation + confidence tightening)
acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/drawdown_adapter.py with DrawdownAdapter class
Monitor rolling drawdown from NAV history
Tier 1 (dd > 3%): tighten confidence threshold by +0.05
Tier 2 (dd > 5%): restrict to top-3 performing pairs only + Tier 1
Tier 3 (dd > 8%): restrict to London session only + Tier 2
Tier 4 (dd > 12%): halt all new trades until drawdown recovers below 8%
Wire into execution.py execute_trade() as earliest gate (before spread filter)
Recovery: each tier releases when drawdown drops 2% below tier entry
At least 10 unit tests
stories.notes: DrawdownAdapter created (~235 lines), wired as EARLIEST gate in execute_trade() before spread filter. 4-tier escalation with hysteresis recovery. 14 tests (12 unit + 2 wiring).
